This '''walker''' was used by both [[Red-armored Er'stacian clan|rival]] [[Green-armored Er'stacian clan|clans]] that fought in a [[Er'stacian clan war|clan war]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Er'stacia]]<ref name="PP">{{Tales|13|Puzzle Peace}}.</ref> sometime between [[22 BBY/Legends|22]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="time">The events of "[[Puzzle Peace]]" must take place between 22 BBY&mdash;the year the Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor was introduced according to {{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|jediwatch/13314_1.html|New Jedi Starfighter Unveiled}}&mdash;and 19 BBY&mdash;the year Mace Windu died according to {{Film|III}}.</ref> These [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] were roughtly spherical in shape, with two [[Er'stacian]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] sitting on top manning large guns. A bevy of [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]] jutted from the sides of the walker, which ambled about on five [[Limb/Legends|legs]].<ref name="PP" />
